main_body: A snow-covered conifer: a stack of three/four conical green tiers with white snow bands and a small brown trunk at the bottom
top_band: none: the column scan shows alternating snow bands and dark green foliage, with no single horizontal top surface above a front face. The snow bands are drape on the foliage, not a top.
evidence: The tree is drawn as a symmetrical cone in flat front elevation. Snow caps are diagonal stripes across the foliage, and there is no top surface band. This is an organic conifer, a shape where the contract does not apply well. By the strict rule, with no top surface and a straight front view, it fails.

style.evidence: The candidate has 13 distinct colours and a median of 8 per tile, against about 108 per tile and 427-567 colours in the references. The outline is tinted dark navy and green, so it is not neutral black (0% neutral). Flat-fill coverage is 5%. The foliage has only 3-4 dark green steps and the snow has 3 steps, with little clump texture compared with the leaf clusters of the references. It is much lower in density and shading depth than the references.
